name: Long-Range Fuel System
description: Auxiliary tanks and a leaner climb profile. Roughly 8% more range without touching the cabin.

name: Blended Winglets
description: Cleaner airflow at the tips. A little more range, a little less burn, a lot more ramp presence.

name: Next-Gen Avionics
description: Predictive routing and better winds-aloft data. Trims block times by about 3%.

name: Ka-Band Satcom
description: Full-bandwidth internet at 45,000 ft. Deals close mid-Atlantic; friends notice the video quality.

name: Bespoke Interior
description: Hand-stitched leather, book-matched veneers, your designer's palette. Arriving becomes an entrance.

name: Master Suite & Shower
description: A real bed and a real shower. Land after 14 hours looking like you drove over.

name: Chef's Galley
description: Induction, convection, a wine fridge and a chef on call. Cabin service becomes a course menu.

name: Low Cabin Altitude Kit
description: Cabin held at 3,000 ft instead of 6,000. Quieter body, quicker recovery, sharper first evening.

name: Discreet Security Package
description: Comms hardening, vetted crew rotation, a name that never appears on the manifest.

name: Curated Art Wall
description: Museum-grade mounts and climate control for two rotating pieces from your collection.
